coordinates.root_origin: Grounded center of the four weightbearing sole-contact extents, (0,0,0); tail and shoulder spikes do not affect placement origin.

concept.reason: Real skeletal display photo plus museum morphology facts sufficient.

scope: Whole animal with short broad skull, paired dorsal plates and shoulder spikes.

scale.basis: NHM Dino Directory estimate; AMNH gives4m and SUSE4.3-4.5m. Not exact measured individual.

specimen_basis: Real skeletal display photograph on SUSE university page. Display restored composite/mount not intact in-situ holotype. Holotype IVPP V6728 skull and partial skeleton; no claim all mount bones original.
diagnostic_targets: Short broad wedge-shaped skull unlike long slender later stegosaur head; front-jaw teeth existed, closed mouth allowed.
Two aligned paired rows of relatively small narrow triangular plates/spines, not huge alternating Stegosaurus diamonds.
One parascapular shoulder spike per side projecting laterally and slightly rearward; not located on hips.
Four weightbearing legs, forelimbs relatively long for a stegosaur, avoid extremely steep Stegosaurus hip slope.
Tail with two pairs of terminal spines and no club; compact whole body.
uncertainties: Plate count, exact arrangement, shoulder-spine orientation and soft tissues reconstructed; paired rows literature museum supported but not an in-situ complete row measurement.
4.5m approximate species scale, not exact IVPP V6728 length.
Skin colour and thickness inferred; neutral muted palette.
acceptance_checks: Short head, two shoulder spines and paired small dorsal rows apparent in top/front/side views.
Whole body four legs and long tail with four terminal spikes.
No Stegosaurus giant plates or exaggerated rear-leg height.
handoff_contract: Same dir maker QA; fixedhash COMPLETE stops; root async backup local-first integration. No maker upload cleanup.

maker_design_freeze.source_profiles: continuous head/neck/trunk/tail loft, four articulated limbs, paired lenticular triangular blades
maker_design_freeze.plate_count_uncertainty: Artist-selected conservative number, not a measured specimen count
maker_design_freeze.feet: Simplified weightbearing feet; exact digit anatomy not asserted
maker_design_freeze.palette: Interpretive muted olive and earth keratin
